effectiveness.","Missing evidence has not been treated as negative ruler evidence.","Local country conditions, congressional acts, court rulings, state conduct, agency conduct, subordinate conduct, established.","Gateway-only material, inaccessible raw-PDF candidates, rejected sources, context-only local facts, and duplicated source-family claims must remain excluded from defensible evidence operationally complete."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal evidence review completed after all permitted research rounds.
